title: Long War Index unit types export (unit_types/core.json)
description: The unit types of §17.0. Each unit type page on the site is one item. The page is the source of all values.

data_version.description: Hash of the file content. It changes only when the content changes.

id.description: Permanent: never changed or reused. For example unit_types/bike.

movement.description: The base Movement (M) characteristic, as printed: "12\"" or "20-30\"". Not present if the page gives none.

rules.description: The special rules that the type gives, in page order. Empty if the type gives none.

text.description: The text as plain text, in the form of the special rules export: no Markdown, no HTML and no wiki links. One blank line separates two paragraphs. Each list item is on its own line and starts with "- ". Each row of a table is one line, with a tab character between two cells.

rule_reference.description: A rule reference, as in the effects of the special rules export.

rule.description: The id of the rule in special_rules/core.json.

param.description: The value of the rule, for example "1" for Hammer of Wrath (1).
